title: 可開合體育場屋頂
summary: 可開合屋頂同時是大跨度鋼結構與一部大型行走機械：固定主結構承受軌道與移動屋面板，轉向架把輪壓傳入軌道梁，驅動與制動在限定風速下讓屋面板同步移動。本課以多倫多 SkyDome（今 Rogers Centre）、亞特蘭大賓士體育場、溫布頓中央球場與福岡巨蛋為例，建立狀態荷載、輪壓、驅動功率、偏斜控制、試運轉與長期維護的工程判斷。
summaryEn: A retractable roof is both a long-span steel structure and a large travelling machine: the fixed primary structure carries rails and moving panels, bogies deliver wheel loads into rail girders, and drives and brakes move the panels in step below a set wind speed. Using Toronto's SkyDome (now Rogers Centre), Atlanta's Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Wimbledon's Centre Court and Fukuoka Dome, the course builds engineering judgement on state-dependent loads, wheel loads, drive power, skew control, commissioning and long-term maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一片屋面板質量 1,200 t，坐在 16 個車輪上，行程 70 m，運轉風速上限 25 m/s。重量 W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN；平均輪壓 735.8 kN，不均勻係數 1.3 時設計輪壓 ≈ 956 kN。行走阻力：滾動 W×0.005 = 58.9 kN，主桁架撓曲造成的 1% 坡度 W×0.01 = 117.7 kN，風壓 q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa 乘迎風面積 600 m² 得 229.7 kN，合計 F ≈ 406 kN。速度 v = 0.12 m/s 時輸出功率 P = F·v ≈ 48.8 kW，效率 0.85 時輸入約 57.4 kW；附著係數 0.15 需驅動輪正壓力 ≈ 2,708 kN，至少 4 個驅動輪。全程時間 t = 70/0.12 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min。若把運轉風速上限提高到 30 m/s，風力變為 229.7×(30/25)² ≈ 331 kN，總阻力 ≈ 507 kN，輸入功率增為約 71.6 kW，驅動輪正壓力需求也增加約 25%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際體育場的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 1,200 t panel sits on 16 wheels, travels 70 m and has an operating wind limit of 25 m/s. Its weight is W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN; the mean wheel load is 735.8 kN, and with an unevenness factor of 1.3 the design wheel load is about 956 kN. Travel resistance: rolling W×0.005 = 58.9 kN, a 1% gradient from truss deflection W×0.01 = 117.7 kN, and wind q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa on 600 m² giving 229.7 kN, for a total F ≈ 406 kN. At v = 0.12 m/s the output power is P = F·v ≈ 48.8 kW, about 57.4 kW input at 0.85 efficiency; an adhesion coefficient of 0.15 needs about 2,708 kN on driven wheels, so at least four driven wheels. Travel time is t = 70/0.12 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min. Raising the operating limit to 30 m/s makes the wind force 229.7×(30/25)² ≈ 331 kN and the total about 507 kN, so input power rises to about 71.6 kW and the required normal load on driven wheels rises by about 25%. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real stadium.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合」與「移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load combinations for open, closed and moving states" and "Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load combinations for open, closed and moving states: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「運轉風速門檻」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Operating wind limit” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 可開合屋頂至少有三種結構狀態：全閉、全開停放，以及正在移動。停放狀態的屋面板由夾軌器或鎖定裝置固定，必須承受設計回歸期的風與雪；移動狀態下屋面板只靠車輪與驅動器約束，因此業主會訂出運轉風速上限，超過就不得開合。溫布頓中央球場的移動屋頂設計採用百年回歸期的雪與風，並規定約 25 m/s 以上不運轉；Rogers Centre 的屋頂則要求在約 40 mph 的風中仍能操作。設計者必須把每一種狀態都列成獨立的荷載組合，而不是只算一個「完成後」的模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「運轉風速門檻」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A retractable roof has at least three structural states: fully closed, fully open and parked, and moving. When parked, panels are held by rail clamps or locking devices and must resist design-return-period wind and snow; while moving they are restrained only by wheels and drives, so owners set an operating wind limit above which the roof may not move. Wimbledon's Centre Court moving roof was designed for 1-in-100-year snow and wind and is not operated above about 25 m/s, while Rogers Centre's roof is required to operate in winds up to about 40 mph. Each state must be listed as its own load combination rather than relying on a single as-built model. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Operating wind limit” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風壓 q = ½ρV²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind pressure q = ½ρV².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「運轉風速門檻」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Operating wind limit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load combinations for open, closed and moving states" is correct?
options: 可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。
可開合屋頂至少有三種結構狀態：全閉、全開停放，以及正在移動。
軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。

quiz.explanationEn: A retractable roof has at least three structural states: fully closed, fully open and parked, and moving. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load combinations for open, closed and moving states: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「運轉風速門檻」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Operating wind limit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風壓 q = ½ρV²。運轉上限 V = 25 m/s 時 q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa；停放設計風速 V = 45 m/s 時 q ≈ 1,240 Pa，兩者相差 (45/25)² = 3.24 倍，所以移動機構只需承受約 1/3 的風壓，但停放鎖定必須承擔全部設計風力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind pressure q = ½ρV². At an operating limit of V = 25 m/s, q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa; at a parked design speed of V = 45 m/s, q ≈ 1,240 Pa, a ratio of (45/25)² = 3.24, so the travelling machinery sees about one third of the design pressure while the parking locks must carry the full design wind force. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在設計基準文件中列出每一狀態（全閉、全開、移動中、停在中間位置）的風、雪、溫度與地震組合，並要求風洞試驗分別提供開啟與閉合幾何下的壓力係數；審查時逐一核對驅動與鎖定元件是否各自對應正確的狀態荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List the wind, snow, temperature and seismic combinations for each state in the design basis (closed, open, moving and stopped part-way), and require the wind-tunnel study to give pressure coefficients for both open and closed geometries; at review, check that every drive and locking component is sized for the correct state load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load combinations for open, closed and moving states", which statement holds?
options: 屋面板很重，所以靜止時本身重量就足以抵抗風力，不需要停車制動。
兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。
風壓 q = ½ρV²。
optionsEn: Panels are so heavy that their weight alone resists wind when parked, so no parking brake is needed.
If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback.

quiz.explanation: 風壓 q = ½ρV²。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load combinations for open, closed and moving states: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「運轉風速門檻」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Operating wind limit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在設計基準文件中列出每一狀態（全閉、全開、移動中、停在中間位置）的風、雪、溫度與地震組合，並要求風洞試驗分別提供開啟與閉合幾何下的壓力係數；審查時逐一核對驅動與鎖定元件是否各自對應正確的狀態荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List the wind, snow, temperature and seismic combinations for each state in the design basis (closed, open, moving and stopped part-way), and require the wind-tunnel study to give pressure coefficients for both open and closed geometries; at review, check that every drive and locking component is sized for the correct state load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主需求書應明訂運轉風速上限、量測位置與平均時間（陣風或十分鐘平均），並規定中途停車時的鎖定能力；這些數字要同時寫進結構計算書與操作手冊，由結構工程師與機械設計者共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner's requirements should state the operating wind limit, its measurement location and averaging time (gust or ten-minute mean), and the locking capacity when stopped part-way; the same numbers belong in both the structural calculations and the operating manual, signed off jointly by the structural engineer and the mechanism designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用閉合狀態做風洞與設計，開啟時屋面板邊緣與看台上方的負壓與漩渦可能遠大於預期；屋面板停在中間位置時遇到陣風，夾軌器若未設計成可在任意位置鎖定，屋面板可能被推動或產生上揚。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the wind-tunnel study and design use only the closed geometry, suction and vortices at panel edges and over the stands when open can far exceed expectations; if a gust arrives while a panel is stopped part-way and the rail clamps cannot lock at arbitrary positions, the panel may be pushed along or lifted. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 開、閉與移動三種狀態的荷載組合：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運轉風速門檻」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Operating wind limit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用閉合狀態做風洞與設計，開啟時屋面板邊緣與看台上方的負壓與漩渦可能遠大於預期；屋面板停在中間位置時遇到陣風，夾軌器若未設計成可在任意位置鎖定，屋面板可能被推動或產生上揚。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the wind-tunnel study and design use only the closed geometry, suction and vortices at panel edges and over the stands when open can far exceed expectations; if a gust arrives while a panel is stopped part-way and the rail clamps cannot lock at arbitrary positions, the panel may be pushed along or lifted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「固定主桁架與軌道梁」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Primary trusses and rail girders” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 移動屋面板本身是一個可自行站立的鋼結構，透過轉向架坐在軌道上；軌道梁再把輪壓傳給固定主桁架或拱，最後經支柱進入基礎。關鍵在於主結構的撓度會隨屋面板位置改變：屋面板移到跨中時，主桁架下垂最大，軌道坡度也跟著改變。賓士體育場以 4 道跨距約 220 m、深約 21 m 的主桁架支撐 8 片花瓣狀屋面板；溫布頓的移動桁架跨距約 77 m。設計必須讓軌道在各種位置下的高程差、坡度與軌距變化都落在機構可容許的範圍內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「固定主桁架與軌道梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each moving panel is a self-supporting steel structure seated on rails through bogies; rail girders pass the wheel loads to fixed primary trusses or arches and then through columns to the foundations. The critical point is that primary-structure deflection changes with panel position: when a panel moves to mid-span, the truss sags most and the rail gradient changes with it. Mercedes-Benz Stadium supports eight petal panels on four primary trusses spanning about 220 m and about 21 m deep, while Wimbledon's moving trusses span about 77 m. The design must keep rail level differences, gradients and gauge changes within what the mechanism tolerates for every panel position. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Primary trusses and rail girders” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線近似主桁架撓曲，跨距 L = 220 m、撓度限值 L/400 時 δ = 0.55 m，支點附近的軌道附加坡度 θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010，也就是 1%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Approximating the truss deflection as a parabola with span L = 220 m and a limit of L/400 gives δ = 0.55 m, so the added rail gradient near the supports is θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010, or 1%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「固定主桁架與軌道梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固定主桁架與軌道梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Primary trusses and rail girders” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線近似主桁架撓曲，跨距 L = 220 m、撓度限值 L/400 時 δ = 0.55 m，支點附近的軌道附加坡度 θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010，也就是 1%。這 1% 坡度會直接加到驅動器需要克服的爬坡阻力上。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Approximating the truss deflection as a parabola with span L = 220 m and a limit of L/400 gives δ = 0.55 m, so the added rail gradient near the supports is θ ≈ 4δ/L = 4×0.55/220 = 0.010, or 1%. That 1% gradient adds directly to the climbing resistance the drives must overcome. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分析模型把屋面板放在每一個停靠點與中間位置，輸出軌道沿線的高程、坡度與兩側軌道的相對位移，與機構設計者提供的容許值逐點比較；完工後以精密水準測量在無屋面板、屋面板停在不同位置時各量一次軌頂高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place the panels at every stop and intermediate position in the analysis model, output rail elevation, gradient and relative displacement between paired rails along the run, and compare point by point with the mechanism designer's tolerances; after completion survey rail-top levels by precise levelling with no panel present and with panels parked at several positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「固定主桁架與軌道梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以分析模型把屋面板放在每一個停靠點與中間位置，輸出軌道沿線的高程、坡度與兩側軌道的相對位移，與機構設計者提供的容許值逐點比較；完工後以精密水準測量在無屋面板、屋面板停在不同位置時各量一次軌頂高程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：把「軌道幾何容許值表」列為結構與機械之間的正式介面文件，任何主結構變更（增加吊掛荷重、看板）都要重算軌道撓度並由機構設計者確認，例如賓士體育場屋架另承受約 1,000 t 的環形看板。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make a rail-geometry tolerance table the formal interface document between structure and machinery; any change to the primary structure, such as added rigging loads or scoreboards, must trigger a recalculation of rail deflection confirmed by the mechanism designer, as at Mercedes-Benz Stadium where the roof also carries a halo board of about 1,000 t.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫；長期下來輪緣與軌道側面磨耗不均，屋面板閉合時兩片之間出現縫隙而漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以分析模型把屋面板放在每一個停靠點與中間位置，輸出軌道沿線的高程、坡度與兩側軌道的相對位移，與機構設計者提供的容許值逐點比較。
可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Place the panels at every stop and intermediate position in the analysis model, output rail elevation, gradient and relative displacement between paired rails along the run, and compare point by point with the mechanism designer's tolerances.
A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以分析模型把屋面板放在每一個停靠點與中間位置，輸出軌道沿線的高程、坡度與兩側軌道的相對位移，與機構設計者提供的容許值逐點比較；完工後以精密水準測量在無屋面板、屋面板停在不同位置時各量一次軌頂高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place the panels at every stop and intermediate position in the analysis model, output rail elevation, gradient and relative displacement between paired rails along the run, and compare point by point with the mechanism designer's tolerances; after completion survey rail-top levels by precise levelling with no panel present and with panels parked at several positions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固定主桁架與軌道梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Primary trusses and rail girders” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫；長期下來輪緣與軌道側面磨耗不均，屋面板閉合時兩片之間出現縫隙而漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: When truss deflection makes paired rails sag by different amounts, the panel is twisted, wheel flanges bear against the rail sides and drive current jumps or trips; over time flanges and rail sides wear unevenly and gaps open between panels when closed, letting water in. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計必須讓軌道在各種位置下的高程差、坡度與軌距變化都落在機構可容許的範圍內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design must keep rail level differences, gradients and gauge changes within what the mechanism tolerates for every panel position.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫；長期下來輪緣與軌道側面磨耗不均，屋面板閉合時兩片之間出現縫隙而漏水。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「移動屋面板的承載路徑與變形相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path and deformation compatibility of moving panels" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe.
When truss deflection makes paired rails sag by different amounts, the panel is twisted, wheel flanges bear against the rail sides and drive current jumps or trips.
quiz.explanation: 主桁架撓度造成兩側軌道下垂量不同時，屋面板會被扭曲，車輪輪緣頂住軌道側面，驅動電流急升甚至跳脫；長期下來輪緣與軌道側面磨耗不均，屋面板閉合時兩片之間出現縫隙而漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When truss deflection makes paired rails sag by different amounts, the panel is twisted, wheel flanges bear against the rail sides and drive current jumps or trips; over time flanges and rail sides wear unevenly and gaps open between panels when closed, letting water in. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪壓、上揚車輪與軌道接觸」與「驅動力、功率與制動設計」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wheel loads, uplift wheels and rail contact" and "Drive force, power and braking": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪壓、上揚車輪與軌道接觸：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel loads, uplift wheels and rail contact: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉向架與車輪」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bogies and wheels” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 屋面板的重量經由轉向架分配到多個車輪，轉向架以鉸接方式讓各輪在軌道不平時仍能分擔荷重。但實際輪壓永遠不均勻：軌道高程誤差、屋面板勁度與溫度變形都會讓部分車輪多受力。懸臂式或受上揚風力的屋面板還需要從軌道下方扣住的上揚車輪；賓士體育場每片花瓣配有 6 組上揚轉向架與 8 組重力轉向架，外側軌道專門抵抗懸臂尖端的上揚。車輪與軌道的接觸應力決定了車輪直徑、軌道斷面與材料硬度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉向架與車輪」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Panel weight is distributed through bogies to many wheels, and the bogies are articulated so that each wheel still shares load on an uneven rail. Real wheel loads are never uniform, however: rail level errors, panel stiffness and thermal movement all make some wheels carry more. Cantilevered panels, or panels exposed to wind uplift, also need uplift wheels that bear on the underside of the rail; each Mercedes-Benz Stadium petal has six uplift bogies and eight gravity bogies, and an outer track resists uplift at the cantilevered tips. Wheel–rail contact stress governs wheel diameter, rail section and material hardness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bogies and wheels” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：屋面板 1,200 t，重量 W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN，以 16 個車輪承載時平均 735.8 kN，乘不均勻係數 1.3 得設計輪壓 ≈ 956 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 1,200 t panel weighs W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN; on 16 wheels the mean is 735.8 kN, and an unevenness factor of 1.3 gives a design wheel load of about 956 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉向架與車輪」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bogies and wheels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輪壓、上揚車輪與軌道接觸
knowledge.titleEn: Wheel loads, uplift wheels and rail contact
knowledge.text: 屋面板的重量經由轉向架分配到多個車輪，轉向架以鉸接方式讓各輪在軌道不平時仍能分擔荷重。但實際輪壓永遠不均勻：軌道高程誤差、屋面板勁度與溫度變形都會讓部分車輪多受力。
knowledge.textEn: Panel weight is distributed through bogies to many wheels, and the bogies are articulated so that each wheel still shares load on an uneven rail. Real wheel loads are never uniform, however: rail level errors, panel stiffness and thermal movement all make some wheels carry more.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輪壓、上揚車輪與軌道接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wheel loads, uplift wheels and rail contact" is correct?
options: 屋面板的重量經由轉向架分配到多個車輪，轉向架以鉸接方式讓各輪在軌道不平時仍能分擔荷重。
只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。
屋面板很重，所以靜止時本身重量就足以抵抗風力，不需要停車制動。
optionsEn: Panel weight is distributed through bogies to many wheels, and the bogies are articulated so that each wheel still shares load on an uneven rail.
If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe.
Panels are so heavy that their weight alone resists wind when parked, so no parking brake is needed.
quiz.explanation: 屋面板的重量經由轉向架分配到多個車輪，轉向架以鉸接方式讓各輪在軌道不平時仍能分擔荷重。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Panel weight is distributed through bogies to many wheels, and the bogies are articulated so that each wheel still shares load on an uneven rail. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輪壓、上揚車輪與軌道接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel loads, uplift wheels and rail contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉向架與車輪」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bogies and wheels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：屋面板 1,200 t，重量 W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN，以 16 個車輪承載時平均 735.8 kN，乘不均勻係數 1.3 得設計輪壓 ≈ 956 kN。以簡化線壓檢核 P ≤ p_L·D·b，取 p_L = 8 N/mm²、D = 1,000 mm、b = 120 mm，容量 960 kN，剛好足夠；若不均勻係數升到 1.5，輪壓 1,104 kN 即超出，需增加車輪。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 1,200 t panel weighs W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN; on 16 wheels the mean is 735.8 kN, and an unevenness factor of 1.3 gives a design wheel load of about 956 kN. A simplified line-pressure check P ≤ p_L·D·b with p_L = 8 N/mm², D = 1,000 mm and b = 120 mm gives 960 kN, just enough; if the unevenness factor rises to 1.5 the wheel load of 1,104 kN exceeds it and more wheels are needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型把軌道高程誤差（例如 ±5 mm）隨機加入支承點，求最大輪壓與不均勻係數；工廠端對車輪與軸承做硬度、超音波與尺寸檢驗，現場以荷重銷或液壓千斤頂讀值抽測各輪實際荷重，與計算值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Add random rail-level errors, for example ±5 mm, at the support points of the finite-element model to find the maximum wheel load and unevenness factor; at the factory check wheel and bearing hardness, ultrasonic soundness and dimensions, and on site sample actual wheel loads with load pins or jack readings for comparison with calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 屋面板 1,200 t，重量 W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN，以 16 個車輪承載時平均 735.8 kN，乘不均勻係數 1.3 得設計輪壓 ≈ 956 kN。以簡化線壓檢核 P ≤ p_L·D·b，取 p_L = 8 N/mm²、D = 1,000 mm、b = 120 mm，容量 960 kN，剛好足夠；若不均勻係數升到 1.5，輪壓 1,104 kN 即超出，需增加車輪。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 1,200 t panel weighs W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN; on 16 wheels the mean is 735.8 kN, and an unevenness factor of 1.3 gives a design wheel load of about 956 kN. A simplified line-pressure check P ≤ p_L·D·b with p_L = 8 N/mm², D = 1,000 mm and b = 120 mm gives 960 kN, just enough; if the unevenness factor rises to 1.5 the wheel load of 1,104 kN exceeds it and more wheels are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輪壓、上揚車輪與軌道接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wheel loads, uplift wheels and rail contact", which statement holds?
options: 兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。
屋面板 1,200 t，重量 W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN，以 16 個車輪承載時平均 735.8 kN，乘不均勻係數 1.3 得設計輪壓 ≈ 956 kN。
只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。
optionsEn: If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback.
A 1,200 t panel weighs W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN; on 16 wheels the mean is 735.8 kN, and an unevenness factor of 1.3 gives a design wheel load of about 956 kN.
If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe.
quiz.explanation: 屋面板 1,200 t，重量 W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN，以 16 個車輪承載時平均 735.8 kN，乘不均勻係數 1.3 得設計輪壓 ≈ 956 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 1,200 t panel weighs W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN; on 16 wheels the mean is 735.8 kN, and an unevenness factor of 1.3 gives a design wheel load of about 956 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輪壓、上揚車輪與軌道接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel loads, uplift wheels and rail contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉向架與車輪」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bogies and wheels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型把軌道高程誤差（例如 ±5 mm）隨機加入支承點，求最大輪壓與不均勻係數；工廠端對車輪與軸承做硬度、超音波與尺寸檢驗，現場以荷重銷或液壓千斤頂讀值抽測各輪實際荷重，與計算值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Add random rail-level errors, for example ±5 mm, at the support points of the finite-element model to find the maximum wheel load and unevenness factor; at the factory check wheel and bearing hardness, ultrasonic soundness and dimensions, and on site sample actual wheel loads with load pins or jack readings for comparison with calculation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範中要求轉向架為可拆換單元，預留頂升點與更換空間，並規定上揚車輪與軌道下翼的間隙值與量測頻率；車輪與軌道材料硬度要成對規定，避免較貴的軌道被較硬的車輪先磨壞。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify bogies as replaceable units with jacking points and removal space, state the uplift-wheel clearance to the rail underside and how often it is measured, and specify wheel and rail hardness as a pair so the costlier rail is not worn out by a harder wheel.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪壓集中的車輪會出現剝落、凹陷與軸承過熱，軌頂形成波浪狀磨耗，運轉時噪音與振動增加；上揚車輪間隙調得過大，強風時屋面板先被抬起再撞回軌道，衝擊會傷害轉向架銷接與軌道固定件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overloaded wheels develop spalling, dents and hot bearings, rail heads wear into ripples, and noise and vibration grow in operation; if uplift-wheel clearances are set too large, a strong gust lifts the panel and drops it back on the rail, and the impact damages bogie pins and rail fasteners. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 輪壓、上揚車輪與軌道接觸：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉向架與車輪」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 輪壓集中的車輪會出現剝落、凹陷與軸承過熱，軌頂形成波浪狀磨耗，運轉時噪音與振動增加；上揚車輪間隙調得過大，強風時屋面板先被抬起再撞回軌道，衝擊會傷害轉向架銷接與軌道固定件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overloaded wheels develop spalling, dents and hot bearings, rail heads wear into ripples, and noise and vibration grow in operation; if uplift-wheel clearances are set too large, a strong gust lifts the panel and drops it back on the rail, and the impact damages bogie pins and rail fasteners. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction drives and parking brakes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 推動屋面板需要克服三種阻力：車輪滾動阻力、軌道坡度造成的重力分量，以及運轉風速下的風力。驅動方式可用摩擦輪直接驅動、齒條或鋼索絞盤：賓士體育場每片花瓣以多台 7.5 hp 馬達帶動牽引輪並配有失效安全制動與夾軌器；斯德哥爾摩 Friends Arena 則以場館結構內的捲筒收放 10 條鋼索拉動屋面板。摩擦輪驅動必須確認驅動輪上的正壓力足以提供附著力，否則在坡段或逆風時會打滑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「牽引驅動與停車制動」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moving a panel means overcoming three resistances: wheel rolling resistance, the gravity component on rail gradients, and wind force at the operating wind speed. Drives may be friction wheels, rack-and-pinion or cable winches: each Mercedes-Benz Stadium petal uses several 7.5 hp motors on traction wheels with fail-safe brakes and rail clamps, while Friends Arena in Stockholm hauls its panels with ten cables spooled by drums inside the arena structure. Friction-wheel drives must have enough normal load on the driven wheels to provide adhesion, or they will slip on gradients or into a headwind. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Traction drives and parking brakes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：F = W·μ_r + W·i + q·A：W = 11,772 kN、μ_r = 0.005 得 58.9 kN；坡度 i = 1% 得 117.7 kN；風壓 383 Pa 作用於 600 m² 得 229.7 kN；合計 F ≈ 406 kN。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋面板很重，所以靜止時本身重量就足以抵抗風力，不需要停車制動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 驅動力、功率與制動設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drive force, power and braking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牽引驅動與停車制動」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Traction drives and parking brakes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：F = W·μ_r + W·i + q·A：W = 11,772 kN、μ_r = 0.005 得 58.9 kN；坡度 i = 1% 得 117.7 kN；風壓 383 Pa 作用於 600 m² 得 229.7 kN；合計 F ≈ 406 kN。行走速度 0.12 m/s 時輸出功率 P = F·v ≈ 48.8 kW，效率 0.85 時輸入約 57.4 kW。附著係數 0.15 需驅動輪正壓力 406/0.15 ≈ 2,708 kN，約為平均輪壓的 3.7 倍，所以至少 4 個驅動輪。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: F = W·μ_r + W·i + q·A: with W = 11,772 kN and μ_r = 0.005 this gives 58.9 kN; a 1% gradient adds 117.7 kN; 383 Pa on 600 m² adds 229.7 kN; total F ≈ 406 kN. At 0.12 m/s the output power is P = F·v ≈ 48.8 kW, or about 57.4 kW input at 0.85 efficiency. An adhesion coefficient of 0.15 needs 406/0.15 ≈ 2,708 kN on driven wheels, about 3.7 times the mean wheel load, so at least four driven wheels. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠對減速機、馬達與制動器做負載試驗與制動扭矩量測；現場試運轉時記錄每台驅動器電流與屋面板位置，比對計算阻力曲線在坡段與跨中的變化，並以停電測試確認失效安全制動能在規定距離內停住屋面板。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load-test gearboxes, motors and brakes at the factory and measure braking torque; during site commissioning log every drive's current against panel position, compare it with the calculated resistance along gradients and at mid-span, and confirm in a power-loss test that fail-safe brakes stop the panel within the specified distance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 驅動力、功率與制動設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drive force, power and braking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「牽引驅動與停車制動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Traction drives and parking brakes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 驅動力只按平地滾動阻力設計，在主桁架撓曲造成的坡段或逆風時就會失速；驅動輪附著不足時一側打滑、另一側繼續前進，屋面板偏斜卡死在軌道上，必須以臨時千斤頂或絞盤脫困。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drives sized only for level rolling resistance stall on deflection-induced gradients or in a headwind; with insufficient adhesion one side slips while the other keeps moving, the panel skews and jams on the rails, and it must be freed with temporary jacks or winches. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「屋面板很重，所以靜止時本身重量就足以抵抗風力，不需要停車制動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Panels are so heavy that their weight alone resists wind when parked, so no parking brake is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「驅動力、功率與制動設計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drive force, power and braking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
驅動力只按平地滾動阻力設計，在主桁架撓曲造成的坡段或逆風時就會失速。
只要吊裝重量低於起重機額定荷重，風速多大都可以吊。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Drives sized only for level rolling resistance stall on deflection-induced gradients or in a headwind.
If the lift weight is below the crane rating, lifting can proceed in any wind.
quiz.explanation: 驅動力只按平地滾動阻力設計，在主桁架撓曲造成的坡段或逆風時就會失速；驅動輪附著不足時一側打滑、另一側繼續前進，屋面板偏斜卡死在軌道上，必須以臨時千斤頂或絞盤脫困。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險」與「軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk" and "Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「屋面板吊裝作業」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof-panel lifting” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 移動屋面板常在其最終停放位置或地面組裝後分段吊上軌道，吊裝期間的屋面板面積大、重量重，迎風面像一面巨大的帆。吊掛中的構件受風時會在吊鉤處產生水平力，直接吃掉起重機的側向與傾覆裕度。1999 年 7 月 14 日密爾瓦基 Miller Park 以名為 Big Blue 的大型起重機吊裝約 400 t 屋頂構件時倒塌，造成 3 名鐵工死亡；當天國家氣象局記錄陣風約 26 mph。這個事件讓可開合屋頂的安裝計畫必須把風對吊掛構件的作用納入正式計算與停工條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「屋面板吊裝作業」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moving panels are often assembled at their final parked position or on the ground and lifted onto the rails in segments; during lifting they are large and heavy, and their windward face acts like a huge sail. Wind on a suspended piece creates a horizontal force at the hook that eats directly into the crane's side-load and overturning margins. On 14 July 1999, at Milwaukee's Miller Park, the large crane known as Big Blue collapsed while lifting a roof section of about 400 t, killing three ironworkers; the National Weather Service recorded gusts of about 26 mph that day. Since then, erection plans for retractable roofs must treat wind on suspended pieces as a formal calculation and stop-work condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Roof-panel lifting” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A gust of 11.6 m/s gives q = 0.5×1.225×11.6² ≈ 82 Pa; on a suspended area of 1,200 m² with a drag coefficient of 1.2 the horizontal force is F = 82×1.2×1,200 ≈ 119 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要吊裝重量低於起重機額定荷重，風速多大都可以吊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the lift weight is below the crane rating, lifting can proceed in any wind." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「屋面板吊裝作業」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Roof-panel lifting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 移動屋面板常在其最終停放位置或地面組裝後分段吊上軌道，吊裝期間的屋面板面積大、重量重，迎風面像一面巨大的帆。吊掛中的構件受風時會在吊鉤處產生水平力，直接吃掉起重機的側向與傾覆裕度。

quiz.question: 關於「屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk" is correct?
options: 只要吊裝重量低於起重機額定荷重，風速多大都可以吊。
兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。
移動屋面板常在其最終停放位置或地面組裝後分段吊上軌道，吊裝期間的屋面板面積大、重量重，迎風面像一面巨大的帆。
optionsEn: If the lift weight is below the crane rating, lifting can proceed in any wind.
If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback.

quiz.explanationEn: Moving panels are often assembled at their final parked position or on the ground and lifted onto the rails in segments; during lifting they are large and heavy, and their windward face acts like a huge sail. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屋面板吊裝作業」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Roof-panel lifting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：陣風 11.6 m/s 時 q = 0.5×1.225×11.6² ≈ 82 Pa；吊掛面積 1,200 m²、阻力係數 1.2，水平力 F = 82×1.2×1,200 ≈ 119 kN。構件重 400 t 即 3,924 kN，水平力約為重量的 3.0%，相當於吊鉤處持續的側向荷重，必須與起重機製造商的側載容許值比較。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A gust of 11.6 m/s gives q = 0.5×1.225×11.6² ≈ 82 Pa; on a suspended area of 1,200 m² with a drag coefficient of 1.2 the horizontal force is F = 82×1.2×1,200 ≈ 119 kN. A 400 t piece weighs 3,924 kN, so the horizontal force is about 3.0% of the weight, a sustained side load at the hook that must be compared with the crane manufacturer's side-load allowance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝計畫要列出每一吊次的重量、迎風面積、起重機組態、容許風速與量測位置，由吊裝工程師與起重機製造商確認；吊裝前以吊鉤高度的風速計即時讀值作為放行依據，並確認荷重力矩限制器與風速警報裝置電源與校正有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The lifting plan lists each lift's weight, windward area, crane configuration, allowable wind speed and where it is measured, confirmed by the lifting engineer and the crane manufacturer; release each lift on a live anemometer reading at hook height, and confirm that load-moment limiters and wind alarms are powered and calibrated.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 說明「軌道高程與軌距」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail level and gauge” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一片屋面板通常橫跨兩條以上的軌道，兩側驅動器若速度稍有差異，屋面板就會偏斜，輪緣頂住軌道並產生很大的側向力。長軌道與屋面板本身也會隨日照溫差伸縮，因此通常只讓一側車輪受導向約束，另一側容許橫向滑動。Rogers Centre 的控制系統更新案特別指出，限制偏斜差是避免屋面板卡死、錯位與閉合後留縫的關鍵；賓士體育場的控制系統則個別調整每片花瓣速度，讓路徑長短不同的花瓣同時到達終點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「軌道高程與軌距」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A panel usually spans two or more rails, and if the drives on each side run at slightly different speeds the panel skews, its flanges bear against the rails and large lateral forces develop. Long rails and the panel itself also expand and contract with solar temperature changes, so usually only one side's wheels are guided while the other side may slide laterally. The Rogers Centre control upgrade stressed that limiting skew differential is key to avoiding jamming, misalignment and gaps when closed, and Mercedes-Benz Stadium's control system adjusts each petal's speed individually so that petals with different path lengths arrive together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rail level and gauge” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軌道高程與軌距」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail level and gauge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m，表示 220 m 長的屋面板兩端相對位移約 106 mm，必須由滑動支承吸收。偏斜：行走速度 0.12 m/s、兩側速度差 1% 時，偏斜每秒增加 1.2 mm，若容許偏斜 50 mm，控制系統必須在約 42 s 內完成修正。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m, so the ends of a 220 m panel move about 106 mm relative to each other and sliding bearings must absorb it. Skew: at 0.12 m/s with a 1% speed difference between sides, skew grows 1.2 mm per second; with a 50 mm allowance the controls must correct within about 42 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全站儀與精密水準在固定溫度時段量測軌道中心線、軌距與軌頂高程，並記錄量測時的鋼構溫度；試運轉時以兩側位置編碼器或雷射測距比較屋面板兩端位置，確認自動修正在偏斜達警戒值前啟動，超過停止值時能安全停車。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey rail centrelines, gauge and rail-top levels with a total station and precise levelling at a fixed temperature window, recording steel temperature at the time; during commissioning compare the positions of both panel ends with encoders or laser rangefinders on each side, confirming that automatic correction starts before skew reaches the warning value and that the panel stops safely at the stop value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軌道高程與軌距」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail level and gauge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全站儀與精密水準在固定溫度時段量測軌道中心線、軌距與軌頂高程，並記錄量測時的鋼構溫度；試運轉時以兩側位置編碼器或雷射測距比較屋面板兩端位置，確認自動修正在偏斜達警戒值前啟動，超過停止值時能安全停車。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey rail centrelines, gauge and rail-top levels with a total station and precise levelling at a fixed temperature window, recording steel temperature at the time; during commissioning compare the positions of both panel ends with encoders or laser rangefinders on each side, confirming that automatic correction starts before skew reaches the warning value and that the panel stops safely at the stop value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：軌道驗收要規定量測溫度條件與換算方法，偏斜控制需設警戒值、停止值與手動復位程序；導向側與自由側要在圖面與現場標示清楚，避免維修人員把自由側車輪換成導向輪。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Rail acceptance must state the survey temperature and correction method; skew control needs a warning value, a stop value and a manual reset procedure; mark guided and free sides clearly on the drawings and on site so that maintenance crews never swap a free-side wheel for a guided one.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若兩側都設導向輪而沒有預留溫度滑動，夏季高溫時屋面板被兩條軌道夾住，輪緣與軌道側面產生巨大側推力，可能剪斷軌道固定螺栓；偏斜控制失效時屋面板斜卡在軌道上，閉合後屋面板接縫無法對齊，雨水沿縫隙滲入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If both sides are guided with no allowance for thermal sliding, in summer heat the panel is clamped between the rails and huge lateral thrust develops at the flanges, which can shear rail fastening bolts; if skew control fails the panel jams askew, panel joints cannot align when closed and rainwater enters through the gaps. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 若兩側都設導向輪而沒有預留溫度滑動，夏季高溫時屋面板被兩條軌道夾住，輪緣與軌道側面產生巨大側推力，可能剪斷軌道固定螺栓；偏斜控制失效時屋面板斜卡在軌道上，閉合後屋面板接縫無法對齊，雨水沿縫隙滲入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Rogers Centre 的控制系統更新案特別指出，限制偏斜差是避免屋面板卡死、錯位與閉合後留縫的關鍵；賓士體育場的控制系統則個別調整每片花瓣速度，讓路徑長短不同的花瓣同時到達終點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Rogers Centre control upgrade stressed that limiting skew differential is key to avoiding jamming, misalignment and gaps when closed, and Mercedes-Benz Stadium's control system adjusts each petal's speed individually so that petals with different path lengths arrive together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收」與「風況監測與開合決策」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「試運轉與同步測試」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 可開合屋頂的試運轉要從單一驅動器空轉開始，逐步進行單片屋面板低速移動、全速移動、多片同步與緊急停止，每一步都同時量測結構變形、驅動電流、偏斜與噪音。SkyDome 的設計團隊曾製作約 1:400、直徑約 2.5 m 的模型確認幾何不會卡死，第一次收回屋面板時還刻意選在深夜進行以策安全。驗收指標通常包括全程時間、同步誤差、緊急停止距離與閉合後的水密。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「試運轉與同步測試」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Commissioning starts with single drives running unloaded and progresses step by step through slow travel of one panel, full-speed travel, synchronised travel of several panels and emergency stops, measuring structural deformation, drive current, skew and noise at every step. SkyDome's design team built a model of about 1:400 scale, roughly 2.5 m in diameter, to confirm that the geometry would not jam, and the first panel retraction was deliberately carried out in the middle of the night as a precaution. Acceptance usually covers total travel time, synchronisation error, emergency stopping distance and watertightness when closed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：全程時間 t = L/v + t_a（梯形速度曲線，加減速各需 t_a）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total travel time t = L/v + t_a for a trapezoidal speed profile with ramps of t_a each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試運轉與同步測試」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：全程時間 t = L/v + t_a（梯形速度曲線，加減速各需 t_a）。行程 L = 70 m、v = 0.12 m/s、t_a = 10 s 時 t = 583 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min，可達成「10 分鐘內開合」的需求；若為降低衝擊把速度降到 0.10 m/s，t ≈ 710 s ≈ 11.8 min 就超出。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total travel time t = L/v + t_a for a trapezoidal speed profile with ramps of t_a each. For L = 70 m, v = 0.12 m/s and t_a = 10 s, t = 583 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min, meeting a ten-minute requirement; slowing to 0.10 m/s to reduce impact gives t ≈ 710 s ≈ 11.8 min, which fails it. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依試運轉程序書逐階段記錄：空轉、單片低速、單片全速、同步、緊急停止與斷電制動，每階段設停檢點由業主代表、機構設計者與結構工程師簽認；最終以連續多次全程開合確認時間、電流與偏斜都在規定值內，再做閉合後灑水試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record each stage against the commissioning procedure: unloaded running, slow single panel, full-speed single panel, synchronised travel, emergency stop and power-loss braking, with a hold point at each stage signed by the owner's representative, the mechanism designer and the structural engineer; finish with several consecutive full open-close cycles confirming time, current and skew within limits, followed by a water test when closed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 全程時間 t = L/v + t_a（梯形速度曲線，加減速各需 t_a）。行程 L = 70 m、v = 0.12 m/s、t_a = 10 s 時 t = 583 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min，可達成「10 分鐘內開合」的需求；若為降低衝擊把速度降到 0.10 m/s，t ≈ 710 s ≈ 11.8 min 就超出。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Total travel time t = L/v + t_a for a trapezoidal speed profile with ramps of t_a each. For L = 70 m, v = 0.12 m/s and t_a = 10 s, t = 583 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min, meeting a ten-minute requirement; slowing to 0.10 m/s to reduce impact gives t ≈ 710 s ≈ 11.8 min, which fails it. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試運轉與同步測試」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依試運轉程序書逐階段記錄：空轉、單片低速、單片全速、同步、緊急停止與斷電制動，每階段設停檢點由業主代表、機構設計者與結構工程師簽認；最終以連續多次全程開合確認時間、電流與偏斜都在規定值內，再做閉合後灑水試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record each stage against the commissioning procedure: unloaded running, slow single panel, full-speed single panel, synchronised travel, emergency stop and power-loss braking, with a hold point at each stage signed by the owner's representative, the mechanism designer and the structural engineer; finish with several consecutive full open-close cycles confirming time, current and skew within limits, followed by a water test when closed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：總工程進度要為屋頂機構保留獨立的試運轉期程，並規定在完成全部階段試驗前屋頂須以臨時鎖定固定在設計停放位置；所有試驗數據要成為日後維護比對的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The master programme should reserve a separate commissioning window for the roof mechanism, require the roof to be temporarily locked in a design parking position until all staged tests are complete, and keep every test record as the baseline for later maintenance comparisons.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：趕在開幕前略過階段性試運轉，第一次全速同步就出現偏斜或卡死，屋頂只能長期停在固定位置；賓士體育場的屋頂就在場館啟用後約一年才達到完全運轉，顯示機構調整需要充分時程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping staged commissioning to meet an opening date means the first full-speed synchronised run may skew or jam, leaving the roof stuck in one position for months; Mercedes-Benz Stadium's roof became fully operational only about a year after the venue opened, showing that tuning the mechanism needs adequate time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試運轉與同步測試」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 趕在開幕前略過階段性試運轉，第一次全速同步就出現偏斜或卡死，屋頂只能長期停在固定位置；賓士體育場的屋頂就在場館啟用後約一年才達到完全運轉，顯示機構調整需要充分時程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping staged commissioning to meet an opening date means the first full-speed synchronised run may skew or jam, leaving the roof stuck in one position for months; Mercedes-Benz Stadium's roof became fully operational only about a year after the venue opened, showing that tuning the mechanism needs adequate time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收指標通常包括全程時間、同步誤差、緊急停止距離與閉合後的水密。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance usually covers total travel time, synchronisation error, emergency stopping distance and watertightness when closed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
趕在開幕前略過階段性試運轉，第一次全速同步就出現偏斜或卡死，屋頂只能長期停在固定位置。
只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。

Skipping staged commissioning to meet an opening date means the first full-speed synchronised run may skew or jam, leaving the roof stuck in one position for months.
If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe.

steps.title: 風況監測與開合決策：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind monitoring and the operating decision: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 開合決策不能只看當下風速，因為一次開合要花十到二十分鐘，風在這段時間內可能增強；控制系統因此需要屋頂氣象站、預報資料與明確的決策規則。Rogers Centre 的更新工程加裝了屋頂氣象站以改善開合條件預測，並納入自我診斷與例外報告。風速計的位置、高度與平均時間必須與設計時假設的運轉風速定義一致，否則門檻數字就失去意義；控制系統應在風速超過門檻時阻止啟動，並在移動中風速上升時把屋面板送到最近的安全位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The decision to open or close cannot rest on the current wind alone, because one operation takes ten to twenty minutes and the wind may strengthen meanwhile; the controls therefore need a rooftop weather station, forecast data and explicit decision rules. The Rogers Centre upgrade added a rooftop weather station to improve forecasting of open and close conditions, together with self-diagnostics and exception reporting. The anemometer's position, height and averaging time must match the definition of operating wind speed assumed in design, otherwise the threshold means nothing; the controls should block starts above the threshold and, if wind rises during travel, send the panel to the nearest safe position. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若運轉上限為陣風 25 m/s、陣風係數 G = 1.5，對應十分鐘平均風速約 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the operating limit is a 25 m/s gust with gust factor G = 1.5, the corresponding ten-minute mean is about 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rooftop weather station and interlocks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若運轉上限為陣風 25 m/s、陣風係數 G = 1.5，對應十分鐘平均風速約 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s。現況平均風速 12 m/s、預報每小時增加 4 m/s，到達 16.7 m/s 約需 (16.7−12)/4 ≈ 1.17 h ≈ 70 min；閉合需 20 min 加 10 min 裕度，最遲須在 40 min 內啟動閉合。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the operating limit is a 25 m/s gust with gust factor G = 1.5, the corresponding ten-minute mean is about 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s. With a current mean of 12 m/s forecast to rise 4 m/s per hour, it reaches 16.7 m/s in about (16.7−12)/4 ≈ 1.17 h ≈ 70 min; with 20 min to close plus 10 min margin, closing must start within 40 min. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄；比較屋頂量測與鄰近氣象站資料以建立換算關係，並以實際運轉紀錄檢查控制系統是否在風速超限時正確阻止啟動或觸發回收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it; compare rooftop readings with a nearby weather station to establish a conversion, and use operating logs to check that the controls correctly blocked starts or triggered retraction when wind exceeded the limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「風況監測與開合決策」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind monitoring and the operating decision", which statement holds?

可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。
只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。

A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position.
If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe.

steps.title: 風況監測與開合決策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind monitoring and the operating decision: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄；比較屋頂量測與鄰近氣象站資料以建立換算關係，並以實際運轉紀錄檢查控制系統是否在風速超限時正確阻止啟動或觸發回收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it; compare rooftop readings with a nearby weather station to establish a conversion, and use operating logs to check that the controls correctly blocked starts or triggered retraction when wind exceeded the limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：操作手冊應以決策表呈現：預報、現況、趨勢與剩餘運轉時間如何組合成「可開合、需提前閉合、禁止操作」三種結論，並規定由誰做最後決定與如何留存紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The operating manual should present a decision table showing how forecast, current reading, trend and remaining travel time combine into three outcomes, go, close early or do not operate, and state who makes the final call and how it is recorded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An anemometer shadowed by a new sign or equipment reads low for months, so operators move the roof in winds actually above the limit; or operators watch only the instantaneous reading and ignore the trend, and the limit is exceeded with the panel half-way, leaving it stopped in mid-travel in strong wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「風況監測與開合決策」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind monitoring and the operating decision"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄。

Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it.
If the lift weight is below the crane rating, lifting can proceed in any wind.
quiz.explanation: 以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄；比較屋頂量測與鄰近氣象站資料以建立換算關係，並以實際運轉紀錄檢查控制系統是否在風速超限時正確阻止啟動或觸發回收。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it; compare rooftop readings with a nearby weather station to establish a conversion, and use operating logs to check that the controls correctly blocked starts or triggered retraction when wind exceeded the limit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 風況監測與開合決策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind monitoring and the operating decision: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An anemometer shadowed by a new sign or equipment reads low for months, so operators move the roof in winds actually above the limit; or operators watch only the instantaneous reading and ignore the trend, and the limit is exceeded with the panel half-way, leaving it stopped in mid-travel in strong wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風速計的位置、高度與平均時間必須與設計時假設的運轉風速定義一致，否則門檻數字就失去意義；控制系統應在風速超過門檻時阻止啟動，並在移動中風速上升時把屋面板送到最近的安全位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The anemometer's position, height and averaging time must match the definition of operating wind speed assumed in design, otherwise the threshold means nothing; the controls should block starts above the threshold and, if wind rises during travel, send the panel to the nearest safe position.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風況監測與開合決策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind monitoring and the operating decision" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。
風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter.
An anemometer shadowed by a new sign or equipment reads low for months, so operators move the roof in winds actually above the limit.
