stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」與「控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue" and "Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Operating cycles, wear and fatigue: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「車輪與軌道磨耗」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel and rail wear” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 固定屋頂的疲勞主要來自風，可開合屋頂則多了明確的機械循環：每次開合，所有車輪都碾過軌道，驅動齒輪、軸承與制動器也完成一次負載循環。Rogers Centre 的控制系統要求每年可開合多達約 400 次。軌道焊接接頭、軌道固定件與軌道梁上翼板在重複輪壓下承受局部應力循環，車輪與軌頂則以滾動接觸疲勞與磨耗為主。設計需同時評估結構細部的應力範圍疲勞，以及機械元件的磨耗壽命與更換週期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「車輪與軌道磨耗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed roof's fatigue comes mainly from wind, but a retractable roof adds well-defined mechanical cycles: every operation rolls all wheels over the rails and puts the drive gears, bearings and brakes through a load cycle. Rogers Centre's control system is required to open or close up to about 400 times a year. Rail welds, rail fasteners and rail-girder top flanges see local stress cycles under repeated wheel loads, while wheels and rail heads are governed by rolling-contact fatigue and wear. Design must assess both stress-range fatigue in structural details and the wear life and replacement interval of mechanical parts. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wheel and rail wear” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每年 400 次運轉、壽命 30 年、每一點有 8 個車輪通過，循環數 N = 400×30×8 = 96,000。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 400 operations a year, a 30-year life and 8 wheels passing each point, N = 400×30×8 = 96,000 cycles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「車輪與軌道磨耗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wheel and rail wear”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估
knowledge.text: 固定屋頂的疲勞主要來自風，可開合屋頂則多了明確的機械循環：每次開合，所有車輪都碾過軌道，驅動齒輪、軸承與制動器也完成一次負載循環。Rogers Centre 的控制系統要求每年可開合多達約 400 次。

Rogers Centre's control system is required to open or close up to about 400 times a year.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue" is correct?
options: 固定屋頂的疲勞主要來自風，可開合屋頂則多了明確的機械循環：每次開合，所有車輪都碾過軌道，驅動齒輪、軸承與制動器也完成一次負載循環。
可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。
屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。
optionsEn: A fixed roof's fatigue comes mainly from wind, but a retractable roof adds well-defined mechanical cycles: every operation rolls all wheels over the rails and puts the drive gears, bearings and brakes through a load cycle.
A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter.
If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails.
quiz.explanation: 固定屋頂的疲勞主要來自風，可開合屋頂則多了明確的機械循環：每次開合，所有車輪都碾過軌道，驅動齒輪、軸承與制動器也完成一次負載循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A fixed roof's fatigue comes mainly from wind, but a retractable roof adds well-defined mechanical cycles: every operation rolls all wheels over the rails and puts the drive gears, bearings and brakes through a load cycle. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Operating cycles, wear and fatigue: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車輪與軌道磨耗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel and rail wear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每年 400 次運轉、壽命 30 年、每一點有 8 個車輪通過，循環數 N = 400×30×8 = 96,000。以細部類別 71 MPa（2×10⁶ 次）、斜率 m = 3 推算，容許應力範圍 Δσ_R = 71×(2×10⁶/96,000)^(1/3) ≈ 195 MPa，結構細部通常不是瓶頸；但滾動接觸處的局部應力遠高於此，磨耗與剝落才是主要壽命限制。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 400 operations a year, a 30-year life and 8 wheels passing each point, N = 400×30×8 = 96,000 cycles. Using detail category 71 MPa at 2×10⁶ cycles and slope m = 3, the allowable stress range is Δσ_R = 71×(2×10⁶/96,000)^(1/3) ≈ 195 MPa, so structural details are seldom the limit; local rolling-contact stresses are far higher, and wear and spalling govern life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立車輪直徑、輪緣厚度與軌頂斷面的定期量測紀錄，以磨耗量對運轉次數作圖預測更換時點；軌道焊接接頭以目視、磁粉或超音波定期檢查，並把檢查結果與運轉次數、溫度與異常事件連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep periodic records of wheel diameter, flange thickness and rail-head profile, and plot wear against operation count to forecast replacement; inspect rail welds by visual, magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing on a schedule, linking results to operation counts, temperature and unusual events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue", which statement holds?

optionsEn: Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry.
With 400 operations a year, a 30-year life and 8 wheels passing each point, N = 400×30×8 = 96,000 cycles.
Panels are so heavy that their weight alone resists wind when parked, so no parking brake is needed.

steps.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Operating cycles, wear and fatigue: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車輪與軌道磨耗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel and rail wear” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立車輪直徑、輪緣厚度與軌頂斷面的定期量測紀錄，以磨耗量對運轉次數作圖預測更換時點；軌道焊接接頭以目視、磁粉或超音波定期檢查，並把檢查結果與運轉次數、溫度與異常事件連結。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep periodic records of wheel diameter, flange thickness and rail-head profile, and plot wear against operation count to forecast replacement; inspect rail welds by visual, magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing on a schedule, linking results to operation counts, temperature and unusual events. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應以運轉次數而不只以日曆時間訂定檢查週期，控制系統自動累計每片屋面板的運轉次數與異常停機；車輪、軸承與制動片列為消耗品並保留備品，更換程序要包含頂升點與臨時支撐計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Base inspection intervals in the maintenance manual on operation counts as well as calendar time, have the controls log each panel's operations and abnormal stops, treat wheels, bearings and brake pads as consumables with spares on hand, and include jacking points and temporary-support calculations in the replacement procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven rail-head wear makes wheels hammer, accelerating bearing failure and loosening rail fasteners; with poor lubrication and cleaning, bird droppings, grit and standing water pit the rails, the pits become fatigue crack initiation sites, and a rail may eventually fracture under high wheel load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue"?

steps.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Operating cycles, wear and fatigue: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車輪與軌道磨耗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel and rail wear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven rail-head wear makes wheels hammer, accelerating bearing failure and loosening rail fasteners; with poor lubrication and cleaning, bird droppings, grit and standing water pit the rails, the pits become fatigue crack initiation sites, and a rail may eventually fracture under high wheel load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計需同時評估結構細部的應力範圍疲勞，以及機械元件的磨耗壽命與更換週期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design must assess both stress-range fatigue in structural details and the wear life and replacement interval of mechanical parts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。

steps.title: 控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「控制系統與運轉紀錄」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Control system and operating records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼結構可用數十年，但控制系統的零件可能在十多年後就停產；Rogers Centre 於 1989 年啟用，2015 至 2017 年間進行約 1,000 萬加幣的控制系統更新，原因之一就是舊系統零件不再生產，更新後運轉時間縮短約 46%。可開合屋頂的交接文件除了結構圖說，還必須包含控制邏輯、聯鎖清單、試運轉基準、軌道幾何基準與緊急程序，讓下一代維護團隊能在不依賴原設計者的情況下安全運轉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「控制系統與運轉紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steelwork lasts for decades, but control components may go out of production within ten or fifteen years; Rogers Centre opened in 1989 and underwent a control-system upgrade of about CAD 10 million between 2015 and 2017, partly because parts for the old system were no longer made, and the upgrade cut operating time by about 46%. Besides structural drawings, retractable-roof handover documents must include the control logic, the interlock list, commissioning baselines, rail-geometry baselines and emergency procedures so that later maintenance teams can operate the roof safely without depending on the original designers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Control system and operating records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若每次運轉成功率 0.995，一季 400 次全部成功的機率 = 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135，代表幾乎每季都會遇到故障；若關鍵通道改為雙重冗餘、單次失效率降為 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵，400 次全部成功的機率 = (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a per-operation success probability of 0.995, the chance that all 400 operations in a season succeed is 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135, so a fault is almost certain each season; with dual redundancy on critical channels the per-operation failure drops to 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵ and the chance of 400 clean operations becomes (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「控制系統與運轉紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Control system and operating records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制系統與運轉紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Control system and operating records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若每次運轉成功率 0.995，一季 400 次全部成功的機率 = 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135，代表幾乎每季都會遇到故障；若關鍵通道改為雙重冗餘、單次失效率降為 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵，400 次全部成功的機率 = (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a per-operation success probability of 0.995, the chance that all 400 operations in a season succeed is 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135, so a fault is almost certain each season; with dual redundancy on critical channels the per-operation failure drops to 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵ and the chance of 400 clean operations becomes (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以故障樹或失效模式分析列出單點失效，逐項確認冗餘或手動備援；控制系統更新時以新舊系統並行或分段切換，重新執行同步、偏斜、緊急停止與斷電制動試驗，並與原始試運轉基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List single points of failure with fault-tree or failure-mode analysis and confirm redundancy or manual back-up for each; when upgrading controls, run old and new systems in parallel or cut over in stages, repeat synchronisation, skew, emergency-stop and power-loss braking tests, and compare with the original commissioning baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「控制系統與運轉紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Control system and operating records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以故障樹或失效模式分析列出單點失效，逐項確認冗餘或手動備援；控制系統更新時以新舊系統並行或分段切換，重新執行同步、偏斜、緊急停止與斷電制動試驗，並與原始試運轉基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List single points of failure with fault-tree or failure-mode analysis and confirm redundancy or manual back-up for each; when upgrading controls, run old and new systems in parallel or cut over in stages, repeat synchronisation, skew, emergency-stop and power-loss braking tests, and compare with the original commissioning baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時應移交可編輯的控制程式、聯鎖矩陣、軌道與偏斜基準、試運轉報告與備品清單，並規定任何控制邏輯修改都需經結構工程師與機構設計者審查；建議每隔數年做一次完整的運轉性能複驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover deliver editable control programs, the interlock matrix, rail and skew baselines, commissioning reports and a spares list, require structural-engineer and mechanism-designer review of any change to control logic, and repeat a full operating-performance verification every few years.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：控制系統老化又缺乏備品時，業主只能降速運轉以免過載，開合時間拉長，運轉風速窗口變窄；若交接時沒有留下控制邏輯與聯鎖說明，故障排除只能靠猜測，甚至有人為了讓屋頂動起來而短接安全聯鎖。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When ageing controls lack spares, owners run the roof below full speed to avoid overloads, operations take longer and the usable wind window shrinks; without documented control logic and interlocks at handover, fault-finding becomes guesswork and someone may even bypass a safety interlock just to get the roof moving. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
